decision_scope: Accept these exact two new files as the generated-fixture limited-planner / sealed-sequence / private-target accidental-misuse boundary only.

requirements.requirement: Exact permitted envelope and fixture-only admission
requirements.evidence: Exact top-level/nested key sets; immutable numeric/provenance snapshots; pinned semantic fixture fingerprint; altered and rehashed support rejected; no rich-task handoff API.

requirements.requirement: No hidden target/support in planning inputs/proposals/masks/rewards
requirements.evidence: Builder creates target solely from spec.nominal_target. Independent controls constructed the permitted fixture without a rich case/task. Policy/nominal rewards, proposals, legal masks, cavity and observations remain identical before/after private target objects exist. Private replay proposal/observation/cavity paths exactly match nominal planning.

Full STOP-or-horizon validation, source/objective/tool/initial-observation binding, action-by-action nominal replay and physical record comparison precede loader. Resealed bad inputs/actions/tools/geometry/prefixes/STOP/time-cap records all reject with zero loader reads.

Bytes-backed arrays and recursive immutable metadata; exact schema; sealed detached JSON round trips; source arrays resist writeability reset. Caller spec/plan/binding mutations inside private loader cannot change replay or report due validated detached snapshots.

requirements.requirement: Independent evaluator and positive target-swap control
requirements.evidence: Fresh non-planning evaluator executes fixed action IDs and independent geometry/outcome auditor. Callback guards forbid policy/search/planning-clone requests after private access. Same seal removes 2 versus 0 mm3; rewards 1.1 versus -1.3000000000000003; geometry/proposals/source hash equal, reference hashes differ.

requirements.requirement: Generated reference-only admission; no support/hazard/patient/clinical promotion
requirements.evidence: Exact original/zero target hashes, exact binding, unsupported reference fields/constructors rejected; unsupported clinical/functional outcomes are null and hidden support/hazards/file isolation flags false.

Focused tests cover load, wrong type/binding, changed reference, replay/audit failure and cancelled independent audit. Errors produce explicit sealed failure records or preflight raises before label read; no failure is successful target access.

accepted_proposal_adaptations: Evaluator-owned HeldOutTargetBinding checks source/reference-kind metadata before label loading; private target class nests this binding and fixes provenance/coverage to the generated fixture.
The exact permitted-input fingerprint and two target digests narrow v1 admission beyond a caller-supplied scope label.
Failure durability means immutable sealed in-memory records which the caller must persist; preflight errors raise before private access. No persistence runner is introduced in this slice.
Method/configuration hashes and call counts are caller declarations, explicitly not authentication or independent cost measurement.
